name: @imagekit/api-mcp
description: The official MCP Server for the Image Kit API
long_description: The official MCP server for ImageKit. Upload, search, organize images, videos, and files in your ImageKit media library. Manage folders, tags, and custom metadata by writing code against the ImageKit TypeScript SDK, executed in an isolated sandbox with access limited to the ImageKit API.

IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY.title: private_key
IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY.description:
Your ImageKit private API key (starts with `private_`).
You can find this in the [ImageKit dashboard](https://imagekit.io/dashboard/developer/api-keys).

OPTIONAL_IMAGEKIT_IGNORES_THIS.title: password
OPTIONAL_IMAGEKIT_IGNORES_THIS.description:
ImageKit uses your API key as username and ignores the password. 
The SDK sets a dummy value. You can ignore this field.

IMAGEKIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.title: webhook_secret
IMAGEKIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description:
Your ImageKit webhook secret for verifying webhook signatures (starts with `whsec_`).
You can find this in the [ImageKit dashboard](https://imagekit.io/dashboard/developer/webhooks).
Only required if you are using webhooks.
